console.intro: The same commands and the same live log as the DCC CHAT admin console (/dcc chat <botnick>), for an operator who would rather not keep a second IRC client open, or run without a debug channel at all. Type help for the full command list.
console.note: ban, unban, clearqueue, rehash and update reply immediately with just an acknowledgement — their result appears a moment later in the log above, the same as it would in a DCC CHAT window.
download.bulkFetchNote: One request per line, in the exact shape a real IRC channel command uses - !<bot> <filename> - the same shape the Search view's broadcast-result "Download" buttons produce under the hood. Example:
download.nothingToQueue: Nothing to queue - paste at least one "!<bot> <filename>" line.
download.queuedRequests: Queued {count} request(s) - see the Downloads table below.
download.confirmRemoveQueued: Remove this queued request? Nothing has been downloaded yet.
download.confirmDeleteFile: Delete this fetched file? This cannot be undone.
download.waiting.paused: Paused - resume it to carry on
download.queuedForFetch: Queued {count} file(s) for fetch - see Queue → Downloads.
filelists.downloadSelectedTitle: Tick the files you want. Shift-click a second box to take everything between it and the last one you touched.
filelists.purgeOfflineTitle: Forget every held list whose bot is not in a channel with you right now (the red dot above). A bot that is here, or one we have not finished checking, is left alone.
filelists.addSourceLabel: Add a bot that does not advertise
filelists.forgetSourceTitle: Forget a bot you added by hand. One that advertises cannot be forgotten - it would be back at its next advert.
filelists.sourceAdded: {nick} added. It shows grey until it advertises or you fetch its list.
filelists.sourceAlreadyKnown: {nick} was already in the list; it is now kept until you forget it.
filelists.sourceNotOnDisk: But the bot registry could not be written to disk - the change is lost at the next restart unless a later save succeeds. Check the daemon log and the data directory.
filelists.typeANickToForget: Type the nick to forget in the box first.
filelists.handEnteredTitle: You added this bot by nick. It has not been seen advertising.
filelists.purgeThisBotTitle: Remove everything downloaded from this bot: every list, its files and its search index rows.
filelists.redownloadTitle: Ask this bot for its list again. Progress is on the Downloads tab.
filelists.redownloadRequested: Asked {bot} for its list again - track it on the Downloads tab.
filelists.fetchRequested: Requested {bot}’s list - track its progress on the Download tab; it will appear in the switcher below once fetched.
filelists.confirmPurgeOffline: Forget every held list whose bot is not in a channel with you right now? A bot that is here, or one still joining, is left alone - this only removes the red-dot rows.
filelists.nothingToPurge: Nothing to purge - no held list is currently showing the red dot.
filelists.leftAloneOne: Left {skipped} alone - a fetch is still in flight for it.
filelists.leftAloneMany: Left {skipped} alone - a fetch is still in flight for them.
filelists.noListHeldFor: No list held for {bot} yet. Press Fetch to ask for it.
filelists.listsBadgeTitle: {count} lists - open this bot to switch between them.
filelists.notDownloadedClickToFetch: You have not downloaded this bot's list. Click to put its nick in the fetch box.
filelists.presenceHere: In a channel with this bot now
filelists.presenceNotInChannel: Not in any channel this bot is in - a request would go nowhere
filelists.freshnessChanged: Their list has changed since you downloaded it. They advertised {then} when you downloaded it, and now advertise {now}.
filelists.freshnessUnknownDetail: Cannot tell - we have not seen what they advertise, or they publish no date or count
filelists.rowCappedNote: — fewer folders on this page: one or more of them holds enough files to reach the per-page limit on its own. Next shows the rest.
filelists.selectFolderTitle: Select every file in this folder
filelists.truncatedInFolder: Showing the first {shown} of {total} files in this folder.
filelists.truncatedInList: Showing the first {shown} of {total} files in this list.
filelists.requestedFolderRar: Requested {bot}’s folder as .rar - track its progress on the Download tab.
filelists.noMatchesInAnyList: No matches in any list you hold
filelists.showingFirstNarrow: — showing the first {files}, narrow the term to see the rest
filelists.everyMatchSwitchedOff: Every list with a match is switched off.
filelists.nothingMatchesFilter: Nothing in any list you hold matches that.
filelists.freshnessBanner: Their list has changed since you downloaded it — they advertised {then}, and now advertise {now}. Fetch it again to see what they are offering now.
filelists.confirmPurgeListDetail: Every list this bot has, its extracted files and its rows in the cross-list search index are all deleted. Fetching from it again is the only way back.
messages.subtitle: People who messaged the bot privately and got no answer, because what they sent was not a command. The bot never replies to these - if you want to answer, message them yourself from your own client.
messages.empty: Nobody has messaged the bot. Requests that use the right command are answered normally and do not appear here.
search.broadcastNote: "Search all bots" sends @find into the configured broadcast channel and listens for 30 seconds. Anyone logged into this dashboard can trigger it - there is no separate confirmation beyond the login you already used to see this page.
settings.keepsPreviousBackgroundWarning: keeps the previous background — this one is drawn as a block
settings.setByHandNote: Set by hand to something the menus cannot offer, so it is left as text.
settings.help.shownIn: On this page the value is typed and shown in {unit}; the file keeps bytes.
settings.onConnectSummary: Sent once the server has registered you and before joining - one command per line, exactly as you would type it into a client. On Undernet that ordering matters: logging in to X takes +x, and joining first shows your real host to everyone already in the channel. Use %nick% for the nickname the server actually gave you.
settings.servedListsSummary: Each list is built from its own folders and answered in its own channels. A channel named by no list is not served at all; a list naming no channels answers everywhere, which only makes sense for one of them. The primary is what a private message means.
settings.noChannelsConfiguredYet: No channels are configured yet. Add them under Identity & network, then come back to bind this list to one. Until then this list serves every channel.
settings.oneChannelNotInJoinList: One channel bound here is not in your join list, so nothing arrives from it. Untick it, or add it under Identity & network.
settings.manyChannelsNotInJoinList: {count} channels bound here are not in your join list, so nothing arrives from it. Untick it, or add it under Identity & network.
settings.addSecondListNote: Add a second list, name the channels each one serves, then save. Nothing changes until you do.
settings.servingOneFolder: Serving {count} folder, in this order. The label is what users see as the first part of every path.
settings.servingManyFolders: Serving {count} folders, in this order. The label is what users see as the first part of every path.
settings.noFolderListYet: No folder list yet — serving the single Music directory below. Add a folder here to serve more than one.
settings.nothingServedYet: Nothing is being served yet. Add a folder here, or set Music directory below.
settings.onlyFirstNFoldersShown: Only the first {count} folders are shown.
settings.typeFullPathNote: Type the full path to each folder. A folder picker is available if you turn on “Folder picker on the Settings page” under Web dashboard.
settings.savedOneFolder: Saved {count} folder. Rebuild the list from Tools before they appear in it.
settings.savedManyFolders: Saved {count} folders. Rebuild the list from Tools before they appear in it.
settings.folderListCleared: Folder list cleared — back to the single Music directory.
settings.themePreviewNote: The periodic advert, and the notice posted when a send finishes. Between them they use all six colours - the advert never uses the accent, so both are shown.
settings.previewCouldNotLoad: The preview could not be loaded.
stats.folderPackingOff: Folder packing is off (RAR_ENABLED), so no album can be sent.
stats.importIntro: Bring your totals across from OmenServe. Your counters live in mIRC's scripts/vars.ini — choose it below and you will see exactly what would change before anything is written. Only the counter lines are sent; the rest of the file stays on your machine.
stats.pasteVarsIniPlaceholder: Paste the contents of vars.ini here…
stats.nothingRecognisable: Nothing recognisable was found in that file.
stats.figuresWillBeReplaced: Your current figures will be REPLACED, not added to.
stats.noCountersFound: No OmenServe counters were found in that file. The totals come from the add-ons (mxrarserver, OS-Limits), so an install without them has nothing to bring across.
stats.importedSummary: Imported. Files sent is now {files}, and the speed record {speed} B/s.
tools.updateListWhat: Rebuilds the master list by walking the whole music directory again — the same rebuild !update triggers over IRC. Worth running here right after setting or changing the music directory from the Settings page, since nothing else prompts for it automatically.
tools.verifyListWhat: Reads the master list and reports any filename that appears under more than one folder. A request that names a file alone reaches only the first copy listed under that name — the rest are shadowed by it. Pasting a search result’s whole line, size included, reaches the copy that size names.
tools.readingAudioInfo: Reading length and quality: {done} of {total} files
tools.updateDone: Done{took}. Check Stats for the new file count.
tools.scheduleOff: No automatic rebuild is set - Settings, List rebuild, "Rebuild the list automatically".
tools.noDuplicates: No duplicates. All {checked} filenames in the list are unique.
tools.duplicatesSummary: {filenames} under more than one folder, out of {checked} checked. {copies} reachable only by pasting a search result's whole line.

settings.field.WEBUI_OPEN_BROWSER: Open the dashboard in a browser at startup

settings.field.WEBUI_CONSOLE_ENABLED.not: Not set: on while the dashboard is loopback-only. Currently {state}.
setup.title: Set up DCCore
setup.intro: A few questions and the bot can start. Everything else is on the dashboard's Settings page afterwards, behind the password you choose here.
setup.password_help: Opens the admin console and this dashboard. Kept as a hash, never in clear.
setup.lan: Reachable from other devices on my network (phone, laptop), not only this machine
setup.admin_host_help: Locks the admin console, and the in-channel admin commands once this is set, to your account rather than just your nick. Log into services, set +x, then /whois yourself for the host - looks like yourname.users.undernet.org.
setup.admin_host_placeholder: optional - blank leaves the console open to the nick alone
setup.folder_placeholder: optional - can be chosen later on the Settings page
setup.note: Only this machine can reach this page, and only until the settings are saved.
setup.saved.title: Saved - starting the bot
setup.saved.dashboard: The bot is starting. This page opens the dashboard's login as soon as it answers - log in with the password you just chose.
setup.saved.no_dashboard: The bot is starting. You chose no dashboard, so this page has nothing more to show: the bot's window is where it reports from now on. Close this tab.
setup.saved.shadowed: {file} also sets ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH, and it is applied after admin_config.py - so after the next restart the password you just chose will stop working. Remove the ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH line from {file}, or change the password from the dashboard, which writes to that file.
setup.error.admin_host_shape: That is not a services host: {problem}.
setup.error.nickname_invalid: That is not an IRC nickname: {problem}.
setup.error.server_needed: An IRC server is needed (irc.undernet.org is the usual one).
setup.error.server_shape: A server name has no spaces, no port and no irc:// - just the host, e.g. irc.undernet.org (the port is a separate setting).
setup.error.channel_needed: At least one channel is needed, like #mychannel.
setup.error.channel_shape: Each channel starts with # and has no spaces; separate several with commas.
setup.error.admin_needed: Your own nick is needed - the person who may run the admin commands.
setup.error.password_needed: A password is needed - it opens the admin console and this dashboard.
setup.error.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setup.error.folder_missing: That folder does not exist. Leave it blank to choose it later on the dashboard's Settings page.
setup.error.folder_missing_no_dashboard: That folder does not exist. With the dashboard off, leave it blank and set FILE_DIRECTORY in settings.conf later, or tick the dashboard box to choose it on its Settings page.
